question: Should this protected Feishu doctor repair be accepted after canonical-state proof and a rebase, or should the session-store owner revise the identity contract first?
rationale: The change touches diagnostic behavior around persisted session state, and the protected label requires explicit maintainer judgment rather than an automated close or merge recommendation.

options.title: Review after canonical proof
options.body: Require a rebased branch plus redacted real doctor output from a canonical SQLite-backed Feishu session, then review the identity lookup against the SDK contract.

options.title: Revise the contract boundary
options.body: If the session-store owner identifies an identity mismatch, adjust the doctor implementation and focused tests before reconsidering the PR.

recommendation.title: Review after canonical proof
recommendation.body: Require a rebased branch plus redacted real doctor output from a canonical SQLite-backed Feishu session, then review the identity lookup against the SDK contract.
